groups.title: Packages with base freight as the primary variance driver
groups.why: Each expected charge was rebuilt from the package’s service level, zone and billable weight using the contracted rate table, then compared with every charge billed on that package.
groups.headline: Base freight was the primary variance driver across these packages
groups.supportCopy: Base freight was the primary variance driver identified across these packages. Financial totals reflect each package’s complete net variance, including differences from other charge types.
groups.mixText: Across these 510 packages the charge differences net to $9,322.20: base freight $9,003.21 unfavourable, fuel $1,322.77 unfavourable, delivery area surcharge $4.98 unfavourable; offset by residential surcharge $790.26 favourable, other accessorials $218.50 favourable.

groups.title: Packages with fuel as the primary variance driver
groups.why: Fuel is charged as a percentage of base freight, so the expected amount reflects the contracted fuel terms applied to each package’s corrected freight on its ship date.
groups.headline: Fuel was the primary variance driver across these packages
groups.supportCopy: Fuel was the primary variance driver identified across these packages. Financial totals reflect each package’s complete net variance, including differences from other charge types.
groups.mixText: Across these 172 packages the charge differences net to $35.10: fuel $33.94 unfavourable, delivery area surcharge $7.94 unfavourable; offset by residential surcharge $6.78 favourable.

groups.title: UPS packages grouped by residential surcharge variance
groups.why: The expected amount reflects the residential surcharge rate in force on each package’s ship date under the applicable contract.
groups.headline: Residential surcharge is the cause Implentio assigned to these packages, and delivery area surcharge contributed the largest unfavourable amount
groups.supportCopy: Residential surcharge is the cause Implentio assigned to these packages; delivery area surcharge contributed more of the unfavourable amount. Financial totals reflect each package’s complete net variance, including differences from other charge types.
groups.mixText: Across these 13 packages the charge differences net to $22.64: delivery area surcharge $42.22 unfavourable, base freight $21.92 unfavourable, fuel $8.86 unfavourable; offset by residential surcharge $48.36 favourable, other accessorials $2.00 favourable.

groups.title: OSM packages with delivery area surcharge as the primary variance driver
groups.why: The expected amount reflects the delivery area surcharge supported by each destination ZIP code on the package’s ship date.
groups.headline: Delivery area surcharge was the primary variance driver across these packages
groups.supportCopy: Delivery area surcharge was the primary variance driver identified across these packages. Financial totals reflect each package’s complete net variance, including differences from other charge types.
groups.mixText: Across these 3 packages the charge differences net to $4.68: delivery area surcharge $4.68 unfavourable.

groups.category: Multiple Causes: Base Freight and Fuel
groups.title: OSM packages with combined base freight and fuel variance
groups.why: No single charge accounted for the difference: base freight was rebuilt from the package’s shipment facts and fuel was recalculated from the corrected freight, and both contributed to the package result.
groups.headline: Base freight and fuel together drove the variance on these packages
groups.supportCopy: Base freight and fuel was the primary variance driver identified across these packages. Financial totals reflect each package’s complete net variance, including differences from other charge types.
groups.mixText: Across these 154 packages the charge differences net to $3.08: base freight $1.54 unfavourable, fuel $1.54 unfavourable.
